note: The refusal twin of split-partition-implicit-case-twins-bind-while-another-split-is-pending, with the same source: here a split is declared for every delivered literal (Kon and KON to 1.5.kon, LEFT to 1.5.left) beside the unmatched 1.5.other, so the family's ambiguity has no unresolved native row left to explain. The replaced test's second leg refused an ambiguity that lacks an unresolved native identity, with this message. The build aborts with that bare ValueError, unlocated, even in diagnostic mode (source_scope.py `_attribute_unresolved_names`); it is on the located-errors list, and a located code or a stale-entry outcome for 1.5.other will change this expectation. Found by #1313.
fails_if: `_attribute_unresolved_names` (source_scope.py) drops its `if not unresolved.get(key)` refusal, so an ambiguity whose family is fully bound passes silently instead of stopping the build

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon in 2020 (CVID 20), KON in 2021 (CVID 21) and LEFT in 2021 (CVID 22).
